slot.brief: Give the IUPAC name of a complex (e.g. [Co(NH3)5Cl]Cl2) or formula from name.

stem: What is the IUPAC name of $\text{K}_2[\text{Zn(OH)}_4]$?

verdicts.working: The complex ion has charge −2. With four OH⁻ ligands, zinc is +2; the anionic complex is named tetrahydroxidozincate(II).

working:
$[\text{Zn(OH)}_4]^{2-}$; let the oxidation state of Zn be $x$. 
$x+4(-1)=-2 \Rightarrow x=+2$. 
The complex ion is anionic, so the metal name becomes zincate. 
Name: potassium tetrahydroxidozincate(II).
